title: FBI-UAP-D022, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-6, Western United States Event, 2026
what_is_it: An artist's digital rendering (illustration) of a reported UAP incident, prepared by the FBI at the Department of War's request; there is no readable body text, only metadata.
interpretation_warnings: No readable document text was extracted; every fact here comes from the war.gov CSV metadata and filename, not from the image or an underlying report.
This is an artist's interpretation, not a photograph or sensor capture — visual details are illustrative and should not be treated as direct evidence of what was seen.
The depiction rests on a single first-hand account from one federal law enforcement special agent (documented in DOW-UAP-D080); it is single-source and unverified.
The specific 'sensitive national security site' is not named, so the location cannot be independently confirmed.
The rendering was created in 2026, roughly two to three years after the October 2023 events it depicts.

key_facts.value: Digital rendering / artistic interpretation (not a photograph)
